name: review
description: Assess observations against a criterion, with a reason for each and exact counts.

main.description: Review observations against a criterion; leave both blank for the sample.

arguments.name: observations
arguments.description: The observations to assess, one per entry.
default: The nightly backup finished in 42 minutes on Monday.
Tuesday's backup log shows it completed after 3 hours 10 minutes.
The backup server was moved to a new rack on Wednesday.

arguments.name: criterion
arguments.description: The claim each observation supports, contradicts or leaves uncertain.
arguments.default: Nightly backups finish within one hour.

inputs.observation: The nightly backup finished in 42 minutes on Monday.
inputs.criterion: Nightly backups finish within one hour.
